items.description: Ritchie Bros. Auctioneers have partnered with uShip to bring customers oversized shipping options. A Customer benefits by sending one req and receiving multiple quotes or quick shipping estimates based on similar jobs completed through the uShip marketplace.
CycleTrader.com leverages the Uship API to provide users with bulk and large item shipping costs.

Hybrid Mail certainly isnâ€™t new â€“ although many existing services serve only the business-to-business market. Elementary Mail is bringing a fresh introduction to this already popular concept, with a consumer-geared service for the everyday person.

FindHorsesForSale.net lets horse shoppers find horses around the wold. Users can view pictures, price, location, breed info, nearby stables, estimated payments, estimated shipping costs, and estimated yearly food costs.
Track FedEx packages--with per-segment CO2 estimates.
Provides tracking information of DHL packages, with visualized package locations on Google Maps.
Provides tracking information of UPS packages, with visualized package locations on Google Maps.
Provides tracking information of FedEx packages, with visualized package locations on Google Maps.
Allows Box.net users to send documents from their Box.net account to FedEx, where they can be printed and shipped.
Offers billing software for creating or modifying invoice reports and provides IE password recovery. Uses the US Postal Service API.

Social Interest is a system for connecting families with a range of publicly funded health and human service programs in California. Communities can use it to screen people for programs such as Medi-Cal, Healthy Families, local health insurance programs.
A wholesale electronics distributor. Integrates PayPal API as well as UPS and other shipping APIs.

MoreMap is a Google Maps Mashup which allows users to track packages, find radio stations, local banks, movie theaters with up to the minute show times, track earthquakes, view interesting places, save places, and get directions.

Track your packages with Google Maps and RSS feeds! Track UPS, FedEx, USPS, and DHL. PackageMapping.com really works and is free to the public. See where your package is as it makes its way across the map. Check it out and bookmark it!

A CATastrophic Android app by Pura Vida Apps using thecatapi.com Every few seconds another cat will be displayed. This is something for cat lovers! Enjoy! This project has been developed with App Inventor. You can find a screenshot of the relevant parts of the source code here: http://puravidaapps.com/caturday.php
Find good music and drinks in the NYC and NJ areas with the map that plots data from the Crooked Beat venue and calendar database.

Netto is a Danish discount supermarket operating in Denmark, Germany, Poland, and Sweden. This mobile app utilizes several Dansk Supermarked APIs. The app contains: - Offers from the Net newspaper (Net newspaper) - Price Check - Use the scanner in the app to scan an item's barcode and get the price in your local Net. - Quick shopping list with bidding match (Purchase list) - The network app usually suggests purchased items and recalls what you buy. It also shows you when your items are on offer in the offer. - Sharing of your shopping list with family or friends, if you have written your shopping list on your tablet, you can also send the shopping list to your phone. - The ability to put your shopping list on your Apple Watch - Find stores and hours (Find Net).
Monitors Rhapsody for tracks played and automatically submits them to a users Last.fm profile.
Soccer Shots is a intro-to-soccer provider across the globe. Its messaging system uses the AT&T in-app messaging API.

File2Cart is an automated SaaS that provides import of products from .xml, .txt and .csv files to any of 34 supported shopping carts. It gives an opportunity to update your product database accurately. Depending on your needs you can choose One-Time or Scheduled Store Import. With One-Time Import you can move the entities from a file to your store database quickly and safely. You can use Assisted Import which allows the whole procedure be performed by File2Cart engineers. Scheduled Import gives the opportunity to update your product catalogue on regular basis - daily or weekly, in the exact hours. The prices of service are moderate depending on the quantity of the entities you want to import. You can estimate the cost of your import beforehand with Import Estimator service.
A worldwide directory of fruit trees, edible plants, and other community food resources.
Convert HTML forms with content to PDF. Lets visitors of your webpages convert the page including the form data they filled in to PDF, with just a single click.
Reskin your iGoogle page and share your skins with others by submitting to the directory.
Segment is the web application that lets users collect, manage and route their customer analytics data. This mashup uses the Pipl API.
Turn your LinkedIn and Facebook profile into Europass CV/Language Passport!
The site allows you to search YouTube videos and then merge and edit them together to make power hour videos. Once the video is published, it is keyworded from YouTube's data api.

Has Virtual Earth with new custom high-resolution images for the Horsham, UK town centre. An entire urban area that has its Virtual Earth images updated. Also has Flash to play audio and display images that are streamed on demand.
Demo application for SlashDB developed by the Code for America Jersey City brigate (OpenJC). Output can be seen in HTML, XML, XSD, JSON, CSV.
Twyric is the art of mashing up Twitter poems with Flickr images for contemplation. Twyric = Twitter + lyric.

Get to know any British Member of Parliament. Select by location, postcode or name. Traversing the UK map provides a constituency grid and instant feedback of its local MP. Extra information provides anecdotal quotes and wiki entries for the local area.

MagTrack is a mobile app for Magento store owners. Use MagTrack's Android app to track sales data in real time, and receive push notifications about sales activity. The app tracks information like total sales, bestsellers, and order and customer details.
Iran Election Protest Tweets from Middle East, Europe, Eastern and Western United States
Uses route planning in Google Maps API to enable you to plan your route to a Premier Inn Hotel.
An AJAX-powered Twitter client that allows for logging in to multiple accounts simultaneously. Hashtags displayed in ComboTweet are automatically linked into Tagalus.
Lagunagram pulls photos from Instagram and displays posts from in and around downtown Laguna Beach in real-time.
This is a platform to search for videos across the internet archive. It uses JavaFX as the technology to build the application.
Google Maps can easily be customized to display searchable floor plans. A floor plan drawing in PDF, JPG, GIS, CAD formats, can be displayed on the map as seen in this example.

A portal for the UK's leading live entertainment locations featuring traditional theaters, concert halls, night clubs, arenas etc.. Listed by county or region. Simply select your chosen area from the menu and click on Visit Website, which will be displayed on the map.
Watch the internet as it's being uploaded. Every 10 seconds it grabs the newest public photo from Flickr.

Use Call the Company to directly call human representatives at major companies. Just type in the company and/or department you are searching for, and click to connect right in your browser so you don't have to use expensive cell phone or long-distance minutes.
The GermTrax Mashup allows tracking the spread of sickness and disease via real-time symptom reports from around the world.
Let's Make a Puzzzzle allows users to upload a photo and turn it into a puzzle. Choose difficulty levels ranging from passing time to nearly impossible.

SDMX-SAX Faces brings together multiple free SDMX (Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange) data services in one data portal. One of these data services is OECD, which is integrated via the OECD Open Data API.
dr. Nescio is a application that automatically indexes and ranks cities based on individual sights, like museums, parks, hotels, bars and music venues.
CrocTail provides an interface for browsing information parsed from SEC filings about several hundred thousand U.S. publicly traded corporations and their foreign subsidiaries.

FotoFuze is a professional 3D product photography and 2D image enhancement service. Make professional product photography out of ordinary photographs from ordinary cameras, for free, then add them to your Etsy listings.
Social mobile tracking with the iPhone on Facebook. Find iPhone-using friends near you.
Paid service to find bank owned homes and short sales. You can search for free and find approximate locations, all displayed on a Google Map.

Mashup of Amazon (for album/book details), Audioscrobbler (for related artists), Flickr (for tagged photos), del.icio.us (for tagged links), Blogdigger (for media files) and Feedster (for matching weblog posts).
Produces graphs of how often things are mentioned on guardian.co.uk.
Radar2go is a mash up of the cargo api along with Google maps, running on azure back end.

San Francisco zoning ordinance information on the go! This technology offers geo-location, provides interactive zoning maps, information about the code and a way to get questions answered by a City Planner. ZonabilitySF is a great way to get a handle on such an important subject.
Joobel search for local jobs. In German.

Canadian apartment, house and condo locater service with a Google Map of rental listings. See comprehensive listings of apartments and houses for rent including photo galleries, a searchable map and amenity details.
Flash application developed using Flickr and Yahoo Map APIs.
Allows users to add RSS feeds, applications, email and web sites to their personal Ticker. NetTickr is always scanning the users net for new items and displays the content in the users NetTickr.
Kangxi Radicals is an app to identify up to a thousand Chinese characters. The application uses the Forvo API to help with pronunciation.
Fun YQL hack to display images from The Big Picture on a map.
Golf course and syndicated golf news. Integrated Google Calendar lets you see upcoming events.
The redistricting following the 2010 Census is an opportunity to change how the redistricting process is conducted. With knowledge and the right tools, the public can redraw the map on redistricting.
A Google Gadget for website builders. Internet and Web terms, facts, history, events, and knowledge plus everyday tips and advice for building a website, blog or e-commerce site.
See live traffic data in the air: mapped flying airplanes based on live data.
Velocipedia is a web application that lets users find available paths for bicycling in Portugal.
Google map mashup with custom tiles of shaded relief. Nice integration with GeoNames database for place and feature-based searching.
Dutch municipality site that has all building permit requests online.
Parking in DC, mapped on a Google Map.
Waitlist management built using Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs. Schedule notifications, predefined messages and auto responses. Data analytics galore.
Links Google StreetView camera perspective to the orientation of the notebook. When you tilt the notebook the camera turns up/down or right/left. Works with Firefox > 3.6 and a ThinkPad or MacBook.
Preview what every one is stumbling upon in StumbleUpon. Dynamically add or remove tabs for the tag of your interest from tag cloud.

Elsy Arres Flights is a web application that lets users search for upcoming flights by providing their departure location, and their destination. This application uses the Elsy Arres Flights API service.
Export Basecamp projects to PDF. Creates reports for archiving, sharing and reading offline. Now supports images.

Viamigo helps travelers, journalists and travel professionals find authentic, local experiences and insider adventures, by connecting them with travel services everywhere. Integrates the Rezgo XML API into the Bookable Tours section.

Gossipgrind is an automated news aggregator focusing on popular culture, celebrity gossip and news. Gossipgrind accomplishes this by linking to posts from all over the web leveraging the Yahoo Query Language API.

YouTube Cloud is like a tag cloud. Instead of tags, this cloud is based on YouTube video popularity. The bigger the font, the more views that video has had. You can filter the cloud by category and time (today, this week, this month, all time). A video thumbnail preview is shown when hovering over a cloud link. Clicking on the links pops up a dialog to watch the video.

Distant.ly is a web application that uses the Traitify API to accept user feedback to generate a personality profile. This is done by selecting Me or Not Me when presented with multiple images, helping to paint a picture of the user. The web app then uses this information to make suggestions for travel destinations and activities. Currently still under development, Distant.ly is created and supported by web developer Tom Rutka.
Service offered through hospitals that gives parents of new borns the ability to set up a notification list, record a single message when the baby is born and the alert is sent to all recipients.
Rivr is a new social networking utility, using the Twilio and Twilio SMS Api's. Brings freedom and creativity to a social network.

This Netvibes module searches for audio, video, photo or document files from your Orb account matching a search string. Clicking on results can play corresponding video or audio stream, open picture in a new window or download the document.
TumblRSS lets you import content from RSS Feeds into Tumblr.
PhoneTacToe uses the Twilio, Twilio SMS and Heroku APIs and allows you to play a quick game of tic-tac-toe with a friend on your phone.
See George W's life history plotted on this Google Map.
Places Near Me is a web application that takes a user's location and locates nearby services. Types of places include gas stations, restaurants, hotels, and hospitals.
Mashup of Google Map and Instagram that displays Instagram photos based on location. The default is set at the current location and the photos are displayed in a flip board style.
Mashup to search bed and breakfasts in Italy on Google Maps. Customized clustering based on province, with icons indicating the number of actual markers.
A cost-effective app to mass notify your team using SMS. It uses your Google Contacts to help you quickly send notifications without the hassle of managing yet another address book of contacts.

MTBGuru.com is designed for bikers, hikers and runners to publish, share and visualize GPS data, along with photos and commentary, creating an ever-expanding free trail resource and community of GPS users.
Graph your Twitter stats, including Tweets per hour, Tweets per month, and Tweet timeline.
ScanTheNet is a search mashup that aggregates results from Flickr, Instagram, Twitter and Youtube. Discover The Net Live & Share Interesting Content.

An ongoing caption competition that selects two photos from a group on Flickr every day to receive dozens of funny captions. Also uses D3/node.js and Bing image search to show a collaborative mind map for brainstorming caption ideas.

RinkAtlas provides door-to-door directions to ice rinks in North America. The database currently includes over 1,800 ice hockey and figure skating facilities in the 50 U.S. states and Puerto Rico. Rinks in Canada will be added in the future.
Simple Amazon search interface that filters items to show only things eligible for Amazon Prime free shipping.
Just three steps allow you to ind where to recycle almost any product. Google Maps API with Ajax make it easy. The site has a search as you type feature and resizeable screen width.
GitHub Watches for particular user
Rank your favorite artists and albums by an estimation of how long you have spent listening to them. Normalized rankings.

Corobot checks tasks from your cohuman (www.cohuman.com) workspace and does them for you - and let's you and your team know when each task is complete. Corobot is available in two products: Corobot Companion is an intelligent automaton who lives within Cohuman (cohuman.com). He's there to help 24/7 with any cohuman-based project - just invite him in and put him to work! Coming in April 2011 will be the Corobot Task Appliance - which is a dedicated environment to turn your choice of cohuman user into a task-completer with full flexibility to customize and program to complete any task of your choosing.
A weather site that aggregates information about local weather and presents it in a simple visual interface.
An open source free Java Point of Sale system for restaurants. To ensure fast development and scalability, Floreant POS used the Flickr API and Google Custom Search engine.
The Voucherify mashup allows to sell vouchers or coupons for through Shopify. Vouchers can be useful for exams, therapy sessions, and gift cards.
to discover the wonderful world of a mathematic formula. Zoom in and enjoy.

Installable software (currently private beta) to help you learn more about your community thanks to different search criteria and filters that can be applied to your followers and friends. SocialBro's technology allows you to download all your community to your PC and browse them even if you are offline. SocialBro will be available as an Adobe Air desktop application and as a Google Chrome App.
DBStract is a free web app and database builder.
A mashup of Google Maps and Flickr. Double click on a country marker to see popular Flickr photos using a simple Ajax interface. Also includes quick links to Wikipedia entries for each country.
Dial a phone number and log the call in the Microsoft Dynamics CRM 2011 system using ClicktoDial.
Earn/Learn Web helps users find the best websites to earnl/learn. Sites range from best PayPerTask to best SellYourArt.
Mobile Commons provides many ways for citizens to contact their local representatives in the Senate and Congress, as well as the President of the United States.
Learn about the unknown hazards around you - the toxins you may be breathing. PlanetHazard maps over 86,000 companies throughout the US that emit hazardous air pollutants. Excellent mashup.

Twitter Search in 2 separate languages. As an option, we can translate your query into your second selected Twitter Search Language and find tweets that include that translated query. Features include Search-as-you-Type, 21 Twitter Search Languages, Update Notifications and Side-by-Side Dual-language Search Results.
Hockey equipment comparison shopping. Built using the shopping.com API.
View tracks on a map. See music uploaded to SoundCloud spread over the globe. Discover new music and find out what people are doing on the other side of the world.
Create your tweets and post them at any future date and time.
OneStop TripOnline is an online booking company that offers access to information on different traveling-related services such as holiday packages, bus, rail and flight.
Good mashup that plots fun and entertaining quotes from Overheard in New York on a Google Map.
gMOVE is a migration utility for moving your Microsoft Outlook calendars, email, contacts and tasks to Google Apps and GMail. Built using the Google Apps Email Migration API.
Google Hot Trends for India shown live on Google Maps.

I Told You allows you to read all of your and your friend's status updates, in one place. You can also read your friends' old statuses, from when you weren't even friends on Facebook. You will also find all comments related to each status updates. Also exports statuses as ebook pdf, txt, doc.
Using Google AppEngine as a server (FREE!) and Hoiio API, this app helps company setup a corporate directory which transfer callers as they key in the extension number.
Maps and electoral vote counts for the 2012 elections.

An explorable map of the Origin Systems, Inc. game Ultima 7, along with its add-ons and related game, Serpent Isle. I used Exult to extract the map, Virtual Earth to present it, and S3 to host the tiles.
SummerOf.com gives you photos from typical holiday locations. But the twist is that you can select which summer you want to see pictures from, like Paris 2004.
Search through MLS listings in the SF Bay Area via this Google Maps mashup.
Free UK Postcode maps using the latest Royal Mail and Ordnance Survey Postcode information with Google Maps.
India is a large country with many tourist destinations, a wonderful opportunity for tourism. Website : https://guidetour.in/ compbines tours from different companies.

Birdsearch enables users to super their search on Twitter. Search tool on twitter is a gold mine for surfacing the most ¥aluable tweets, whether it's the top tweets, most engaged tweets, viral tweets, tweets from specific users, media, news etc, it makes it easier to separate the signal substance from the noise. However, Twitter search has been stagnant for many years in terms of refining the search, the UX and one cannot construct their own advanced search queries on mobile, which is where Bird search comes in.
Down or Not checks a website from 3 locations in the WatchMouse network and decides if a site is indeed down or not.
German movie portal. Uses APIs from YouTube, Google Maps and Amazon.
SugarCRM is an online customer relationship management application, and its integration with Box.net allows SugarCRM users to view their content on Box within the SugarCRM environment.
Careers Information in some country likes US, UK, Australia and Canada. Use indeed API to pull jobs information source Real time. and used API Google Maps to show the company location.
Goggles is a very fun and creative flight simulator built on top of Google Maps. Pick from one of five cities and go. Change altitude and direction using the arrow keys.
You.travel features a cool interactive full-screen map along with travel guides to over 16,000 destinations, traveler reviews, and over 10,000 photos.
to.uri.st is a geocoded database of tourist attractions the World over. We have a RESTful API to allow reading and updating of our copyleft data.
Allows Box.net users to send files from their Box accounts to Fuze Meeting, where they can discuss and collaborate around them with other users.
Interactive game based on Google Maps API. Try to guess the correct country below the flag.
See what's going on around you. Know the World. In Real-Time. Ask about places you care about and see whatâ€™s going on.
Simple and intuitive search tool, allows displaying photo time and date taken in either a radial or standard X,Y axis plot.
LikeBible.com is a project of a young christian college student who had an idea while cramming and writing finals papers. Users can highlight any word to learn and get more resources on the topic.
Local Daily Deals sourced by 8coupons.
Create online video mixtapes to share with friends. Search for artists or songs on YouTube. Drag results into your list to create your own mixtape.

Episkeptis helps users identify the best restaurants, bars, clubs and cafes in their city, with the help of their Facebook friends. Users are able to rate, recommend and share their favorites. Site is in Greek.

CuteOn.Me is a simple app to solicit shopping advice from your friends. It demonstrates how a real-world application can use awe.sm's batch link creation, metadata association, redirection patterns, conversion tracking, and advanced stats retrieval. Documentation and source available.

SoundsGud is an entertainment and advertising company that creates content for Mobile Operators, Vendors, CRBT Promoters, and more. SoundsGud focuses mostly on sound conversion, to attract their clients customers with advertisement.
London Restaurants, searchable by Tube station and/or Cuisine, complete with live booking service.
Memory game that chooses Flickr pictures as cards, based on a tag you enter.
A mashup like housingmaps.com. It shows the latest flats for sale or rental in Singapore on Google maps.
Do you like dogs? InstaPuppy thought so. This mashup allows you to click through puppy images on Instagram.

School Performance Maps provides a bird's eye view of public school performance in California. Data from California Department of Education, Academic Performance Index. The 1-10 is statewide rank school, low to high.
Downloads all your followers from Twitter and displays the five oldest based on the date that the user began following you.
Storefront built on Amazon eCommerce with millions of products from a wide variety of categories and hundreds of merchants with competitive prices.
Bookafy is an online scheduling and appointment tracking web app. This mashup makes use of the Zendesk Core API for ticket tracking and management.
Comprehensive map of UK schools with comparisons of student scores and search capabilities. Marker drill-down brings you to Dept of Education and Skills site details.

ListTube is a YouTube application for iPhone. Your favorite movies on YouTube are related to a playlist on iPhone through ListTube. * Feature - YouTube video search with suggest. - Easy creating a list and adding movie. - Background audio play. - Movie cache. - Loop play.
A plugin for Apple's iPhoto application to export photos to expono.com.
MusicNectar is a mashup of lastfm, and youtube. The aim of MusicNectar is to make listening to youtube music videos easier, and more informative.
Loc Amigos helps you find your friends all over the web. It will match up friends in your address books with their profiles across lots of social networking sites like MySpace, Flickr, and others.

Moveboxer is the best way to find a reputable mover and instantly get a quote for your move. Moveboxer combines Yelp ratings and reviews with a price estimate so users have more information along the way and can select the movers of their choice to get in touch with them.
Turns your Java-enabled mobile phone or your PDA mobile phone running Windows into a personal real-time tracking solution.
An easy way to upload your TwitPic images to Flickr. Uses APIs from Flickr, TwitPic and Twitter.
AccentTraining.net is a mashup of Twilio, Amazon Mechanical Turk and Recurly APIs to create an accent rating and training service. Create a recording and have it rated by real American residents.

Mobypicture enables you to add postings with pictures to Twitter and also get these directly posted to your Flickr-album. You can use it from your mail client or directly from your phone, so you can show your friends what your doing instead of typing it.

Qabic allows you to effortlessly handle Q&A for your talks/panels by allowing your audience to submit and vote on questions throughout the event. This allows the best questions to be easily accesible both during and after your talk/panel.

LOCPix allows searching and viewing of the digitized photo collections from the Library of Congress. Browse collections or search the vast archive for interesting historical photographs and poster artwork. Hundreds of thousands of images are available, many in high resolution.

CallCollector is a virtual voicemail box to collect calls from fans, customers, groups, or whatever you need it for. A business may use it as a complaint & feedback line. A talk radio station may use it to allow listeners to vent to (or about) their on-air personalities. You might even use it to collect wishes from family all over the county and stitch them together for a relative's birthday or anniversary.
The quick and easy way to make Google Maps. There is also a pro version with more functionality.
A memorial mashup for the victims of Virginia Tech.

Hinge is a dating app available on iOS and Android. Using Hinge, people are able to meet others through connections with their friends. Hinge is also an Uber API partner, allowing users to quickly coordinate date pickup from the chat tab from within the Hinge app.

Vertical search for US Colleges and Universities. The site includes in-depth information such as tuition cost and retention information on over seven-thousand schools. Check out a birds-eye view of the colleges.
Interactive Google Map of the Montreal subway system with links to the Montreal Transit Website.

MapGameDay.com is a community site that allows fans to create map markers to show popular campus locations and create custom game day maps: ticket locations, parking, tailgate party, stadium photos, etc.
Build a Virtual Pin Map of the places you've been.
localpha.com is an local business directory that helps users obtain important information including phone numbers, directions, and reviews.
bliin lets you share your location and geo-tagged photos from your handset in real-time. You can find and follow your friends across the world and share experiences via your phone and over the web.
Ever wanted to see all your Facebook friends on a map? With the Facebook Friends Map you can easily do so.

MisoTrendy helps you find the most popular places around any location. MisoTrendy uses trending data from foursquare and shows currently checked-in users, tips and mayorships from the most popular venues in real-time.
Appraise your Seattle-area house by seeing prices of recent home sales plotted on this Google Map.
Great for runners, hikers, bicyclist and anyone else interested in how far they ran, walked, biked, or traveled. Map, save, find, and share your routes.
Digital marketplace using modified BitTorrent network for distribution. Allows sellers to list their items, and Buyers to get paid for helping distribute.
Generate money on your website or blog with MotionMall's service. Allows you to customize banner ads for your target audience and displays bestselling products using the Amazon API.

Genuinely useful mashup that can help you determine if you are paying too much in rent. Enter an address, apartment size, and rent. It maps nearby units and shows a meter of your price versus min, max and average.
Thanks to PayPal, users can donate money to help friends in times of need.

Trackprofiler is an online editor (and organizer) of GPS tracks. It is designed for hikers, mountaineers, mountainbikers, cyclists and more generally for people who use GPS devices for outdors activities.
Flowd lets you mark your favorite spots on the map and tell your friends where the action is happening. Flowd also shows you the nearby gigs of your favorite artists!
Chinese Google Maps mashup that allow people to share maps.

Website-Grader.com is a website grader and performance report tool. The site allows you to generate a detailed report for any website to view the performance grade, usability grade, and overall grade, with additional reporting on response bytes, compression, browser caching, optimization and much more.

The Bulk Google Rank Checker is a real-time tool you can use to retrieve the rankings for your website or of your competitors. Submit up to 10 keywords at a time and check the rankings for desktop sites in 14 countries and for mobile site in 5 countries. After the tool has returned the rankings, you can export the results to CSV.

This real-time vehicle tracker takes position reports sent a server and plots them as pushpins. The map refreshes at about the same interval as the position reports coming in. Right-click two pushpins and get some distance, speed, and time info.

FindGoodSchool.com contains data on over 100,000 elementary, middle and high schools in the United States. You can simply type in your address and search all the schools around your area. You can compare each school's demographics information and also student to teacher ratio. You can search for magnet, charter, vocational, alternative and shared-time schools in your area. It will help you to find the best school for your kids.
Rotten Tomatoes mashup with reviews for Comcast On-Demand Movies. When you don't know what to watch.
A Twilio clone of the Dial-A-Joke system. The joke with the most votes is considered the featured joke and is played when you call the application's phone number.
Display flickr photos for your Tivo

A cool Google Maps and Tour de France mash-up: Displays drivers data live on a interactive map. And you can can even follow the bike position. Heart beat, speed, stress points, distance, power and current position are tracked.
Dual maps let you display two maps side-by-side for a single location. Use the dual map to combine the features of Google Maps and Microsoft Virtual Earth Maps within one embeddable control.
This Service is a mashup service using twitter and google maps apis. It displays a users twitter status on the globe.
Google Apps and Box.net are integrated, so Google Apps users can access their Box files from within Gmail, create file-based events in Google Calendar, and create Google Sites with content from Box.
Tracks and graphs Amazon price history. Allows user to be emailed when the price hits a desired point.
Provides a more user-friendly way to view the comments left on a YouTube video.
Site that aggregates videos of watches by brand.
MyMemory Language Translator is an application that lets users to translate text from one language to another. This application uses the MyMemory API service.
Real estate facts, terms, people, websites, history, and events in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year contains a reference about the real estate and housing industries.

A free PDF file sharing site where you can upload/download/share PDF collections in private or in public, or read the PDF online using a built-in PDF reader. Doocu is using Amazon EC2 and S3 for storage and database.
A look at the 25 most unsafe cities in America.
This is a one-page site that has fun with the glory of the jesusPad and its followers.

This is a drawing tool for polyline, polygon , polygon with holes, rectangle, circle, marker(icon), direction(route, path). This application uses the Google Maps API Version 3 (V3). It has all the features of Google Maps MyMaps and has direct access to the code for the shapes (overlays) you create.

iMapflickr.com allows non-techie users to create fully customizable embeddable google maps of geocoded flickr photosets or search results. You can use it to create maps of your own photos, or other users.

This project was contributed by Andy Fundinger, a professional Python developer. Andy built this integration as a way to teach his students how to make calls to their mother's using Plivo and Raspberry Pi.
Watch twitters in real time with this live map that dynamically updates to show the latest twitterings.
A mashup of Google Maps, Weather.com and MSN that can help you search the world quickly.
View all Track info, track layouts, and links to track specific information for all 32 NASCAR tracks.

At Sea Scotia Vacation Rentals we want you to have the Nova Scotia Vacation of a lifetime. We have some of the finest Nova Scotia Cottages and Nova Scotia Vacation rentals. All locations are listed on the map.
Vox Populi, a Savannah Morning News feature, uses the Evoca API and a web-to-voice service to let readers call 912-652-0370 to voice an opinion and have it published on the website.

An interactive worldwide map and directory of hotels, airports and holiday destinations containing over 100,000 listings. Be sure to see their World Capitals Map with hovers that show flags of every country.
Displays geographic location of a Domain or IP address on Google Maps.
KGI Wireless are using a combination of MSN Virtual Earth and MapPoint technology to map its wireless towers and associated profiles around the USA.
Create an instant mosaic from your Twitter or LiveJournal friends pictures. You can print it on a mug, a T-shirt, a mousepad or a bag.
http://www.tatvic.com/adwords/index.php
Watch music videos of songs you listen to on Last.fm. Also, watch what your Last.fm friends are listening to. Main feature is the music wizard.
Maps of breweries and bars across the US. With city-specific maps and directories.
